name: Jyoti Jha

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Jyoti Jha writes fiction, poetry and travel narratives in English and Hindi. A former human-resources professional, she found a turning point in The Times of India’s Write India competition, later discussing that journey at Times LitFest. Her books include the Hindi novel Aanandi, the travel title Around the World Through My Lens and the short-story collection Heart’s Sanctuary & Other Stories.

“Hues of Nature” gathers its movement from colour and light: blue sky, green foliage, grey shadow and golden rays. The quiet scene opens into a reflection on solitude and purpose, letting sensory attention become a way of looking inward. Her author website also records the poem’s appearance in the Toshali Anthology of Poetry, connecting this Kabita Live contribution with her wider poetry publication.
